title: Add meal-plan rename flow in detail view
description: Add a Rename action to the meal-plan detail toolbar menu with alert-based name entry, sanitisation, duplicate detection, security-scoped file handling, atomic file move, and local navigation/list refresh handling.
acceptance_criteria: MealPlanDetailView toolbar menu includes a Rename… action alongside delete.
Rename presents an alert pre-filled with the current display name minus the .menu extension.
Save is disabled until the trimmed input is non-empty.
Input is sanitised by trimming and replacing / with -.
Duplicate target names are detected before move and surface the inline duplicate error.
Successful rename performs a single moveItem(at:to:) to the new .menu URL without reparsing or rewriting contents.
The detail view URL or navigation state updates so the stale old URL is not left active, and the list view refreshes if required by existing data flow.

handoff_summary.completed: All 7 acceptance criteria met: Rename… in toolbar menu alongside Delete; alert pre-filled with display name (without .menu); Save disabled when trimmed input empty; input sanitised (trim + /→-); duplicate detected before move with inline error message; single moveItem(at:to:) without reparsing; dismiss() clears stale old URL and onRename callback refreshes entries list.
handoff_summary.risks: Silent failure on moveItem error (matches existing deletePlan pattern of try? / return). If file permissions fail, the alert simply closes without feedback. Consider adding a rename-failed error alert in a follow-up polish pass.
handoff_summary.next_action: Route to tester agent for validation of rename happy path, duplicate-name rejection, and list refresh after navigate-back.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. MealPlanDetailView and MealPlansView are within this bead's declared file scope and no sibling beads claim these files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Followed ShoppingListDetailView rename pattern (dismiss + onRename callback) for consistency. Used moveItem(at:to:) as required by spec instead of write+delete. Kept renameDuplicateError as Bool (not String) to stay aligned with existing MealPlanCreateAlert pattern. Silent failure on moveItem error (consistent with deletePlan's try?) rather than adding a new error alert — a polish-spec follow-up can add that if desired.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written (tester agent responsibility). Key paths to cover: happy-path rename updates list title and pops nav; duplicate name shows inline error without dismissing; empty/whitespace-only input keeps Save disabled; sanitisation of / characters; same-name entry (guard sanitised != planName returns early).
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Move failures are silently swallowed (no user-facing error). Navigation title still shows old name until dismiss completes (inherent to dismiss-based approach). The entries list uses Date() as the new modificationDate rather than re-reading the file's actual mtime — acceptable since rename doesn't change content.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. MealPlanDetailView and MealPlansView are within this bead's declared file scope and no sibling beads claim these files.

execution_history.summary: Implemented meal-plan rename flow in the detail view. Added Rename… toolbar menu action (before Delete), rename alert pre-filled with current plan name, input sanitisation (trim + /→-), duplicate detection with inline error, atomic moveItem(at:to:) file rename, dismiss + onRename callback on success, and list entry URL update in MealPlansView. Build succeeds.
